import json, os
from contextlib import redirect_stdout, redirect_stderr
from io import StringIO
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from scripts.jarvis_network import main
from tests.test_handoff_context_cli import ContextCLITests, REVISION

results=[]
for fail_at in (1,2):
    fixture=ContextCLITests(); fixture.setUp()
    try:
        checksum=fixture.controlled()
        assert fixture.cli('review','--handoff','cli-task','--reviewer','local-reviewer','--digest',fixture.profile['handoff_sha256']).returncode==0
        assert fixture.review_context(checksum).returncode==0
        calls=[]; real=os.fsync
        def fail_sync(fd):
            calls.append(fd)
            if len(calls)==fail_at: raise OSError('Synthetic export sync failure')
            return real(fd)
        with patch('scripts.jarvis_network.os.fsync',side_effect=fail_sync),redirect_stdout(StringIO()),redirect_stderr(StringIO()):
            code=main(['--root',str(fixture.root),'--database','ledger.sqlite3','export-context','--handoff','cli-task','--digest',checksum,'--source-revision',REVISION,'--memory-revision','1','--context-revision','1','--out','private/envelope.json'])
        assert code==1 and len(calls)==fail_at
        output=fixture.root/'private/envelope.json'; envelope=output.read_bytes() if output.exists() else None
        assert (envelope is not None)==(fail_at==2)
        before=fixture.db.read_bytes()
        queue=fixture.cli('--read-only','queue-report','--project','ai-jarvis','--mission','cli-task','--include-review-state','--out','reports/export-queue-001.json')
        recovery=fixture.cli('--read-only','inspect-recovery','--handoff','cli-task','--digest',checksum,'--source-revision',REVISION,'--memory-revision','1','--context-revision','1','--out','reports/export-recovery-001.json')
        assert queue.returncode==recovery.returncode==0,(queue.stderr,recovery.stderr)
        q=json.loads((fixture.root/'reports/export-queue-001.json').read_bytes()); r=json.loads((fixture.root/'reports/export-recovery-001.json').read_bytes())
        binding=q['bindings'][0]; item=r['lineage'][0]
        assert q['handoff_count']==1 and binding['state']==item['handoff_state']=='export_prepared'
        assert binding['context_sha256']==item['context']['context_sha256']==checksum
        assert binding['context_revision']==item['context']['revision']==1
        assert binding['context_review_current'] and item['context']['review_current']
        assert item['context']['execution_state']=='execution_blocked' and item['context']['checkpoint_present']
        assert not q['dispatch_authorized'] and not r['retry_authorized']
        assert fixture.db.read_bytes()==before
        assert (output.read_bytes() if output.exists() else None)==envelope
        assert all((fixture.root/p).stat().st_mode & 0o777==0o600 for p in ['reports/export-queue-001.json','reports/export-recovery-001.json'])
        assert fixture.cli('--read-only','queue-report','--project','ai-jarvis','--mission','cli-task','--include-review-state','--out','reports/export-queue-001.json').returncode==1
        assert fixture.db.read_bytes()==before
        results.append(dict(fsync_failure=fail_at,commands_passed=2,export_prepared=True,output_present=output.exists(),blocked_checkpoint_retained=True,read_only_database_bytes_unchanged=True,private_reports=True,overwrite_refused=True,external_actions=0))
    finally: fixture.tearDown()
print(json.dumps(dict(kind='actual_synthetic_procedure_check',cases=results,actual_owner_mission_accessed=False)))
